授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: Students will be assessed on their in-class presentations (1: 20%, 2: 20%, 3: 20%, and final presentation: 40%).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Students should study on Moodle during class and outside of class.
Each class will consist of a short lecture, followed by practical sessions on presentation skills and slide design. If you are absent, you should make up the work, preferably before the next class.
Students will be assessed on their in-class presentations (1: 20%, 2: 20%, 3: 20%, and final presentation: 40%).
【Caution】 You must create and submit original work for this class. Plagiarism (剽窃), e.g., copying and pasting from the internet, is unacceptable. If you use information from research papers or the internet, you must cite the source, e.g., author’s name and date or URL. Students who plagiarise will fail the course.
【Caution】 The use of generative AI and automatic translation apps is prohibited. Students who use tools such as generative AI or automatic translation apps will fail the course.
